facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communiqué of 3 December 2024 says the Council 'a examiné et approuvé' a bill authorising ratification of the IDA financing agreement signed 11 December 2023 for WARDIP-Mauritanie, which it says will contribute strongly to the realisation of the Agenda National de Transformation Numérique, including new or improved broadband for over 400,000 people; it states no domestic allocation.

systems.tiers: national; no period given in the passages

systems.owner: Government of Mauritania with the IDA
systems.tiers: national; financing agreement signed 11 December 2023, ratification bill approved 3 December 2024

systems.tiers: national; WARDIP is said to be aligned with its strategic objectives
